component.name: Dissonanza
component.summary: A native Linux client for Roon

description.p: Dissonanza is a native Linux remote client for Roon, built entirely on Roon's officially supported API. It aims for feature parity with the official Roon remote — every sidebar category, browse path, and playback control — plus a few things Roon itself doesn't offer: a zoomable tile/grid browsing view.
